summary.text: Verdant Sun Flame Cloak is a defensive killer move. Burning hair turns into a flame cloak that protects the user all around.

claims.text: On a stone lotus island in the River of Time, an old man names the move after spring scissors fails to cut him. He took inspiration from Verdant Great Sun’s flame hair in The Legends of Ren Zu, and calls it his proudest creation. He is a fire path Gu Immortal more skilled in defense than offense, and says spring scissors and summer fan are useless against him. Intense winds from summer fan make the cloak flicker, then the fire grows larger. The move holds the extreme profundity of fire path and also mimics human path and food path. As he closes in, a feeling of drunkenness assaults Fang Yuan. Reverse flow protection seal is extremely effective against attacks, but the reflected damage is quite little. In that formation space, time path is weakened, which is one reason spring scissors and summer fan have only a mild effect. In intricacy, the cloak is on par with myriad self, which comprises enslavement path and strength path.

Fang Yuan names it Immortal killer move verdant sun flame cloak. The old man’s body is covered until he resembles a huge fireball. Sword dragons from myriad dragon grow drowsy as they near, then blaze and vanish. The cloak is both offensive and defensive, and it counters myriad dragon. Luo Po seal scrapes the old man’s shoulder and the blazing cloak on his back weakens by forty percent. He heals, and the cloak blazes up again. Fang Yuan senses its defenses the way his enemies feel reverse flow protection seal. Near the end of the fight Fang Yuan addresses him as Li Huang.

Li Huang pounces with the cloak on him. It can defend against great thief ghost hand. Spring scissors snips the cloak on his back and tears it, greatly lowering its defense. He sees the situation is bad and activates the cloak again during the attack. Summer fan then hits him with intense winds and sends him flying. After that stacked cloak is hit, a tiny spark remains. This fire path defensive killer move can be used consecutively and stacked. The weakness is that the expended immortal essence is twice as high.
